A high-school student just made $20,000 from a Telegram Gift.

I hope some of this year's winners put their Grams to similar use! 📈

title: Quantum computer development is more about national security than profits, says expert
snippet: Japanese electronics giant NEC stopped development of gate-based superconducting quantum computer hardware at the end of March 2026. The decision also reportedly prompted quantum R&D researchers to join Fujitsu.
